status: metadata-first prospective gate specification; no external A12 outcomes opened
scope: At most three primary-source-led independent human lung normal/LUAD single-cell cohorts; no expression retrieval after a decisive metadata failure.
prior_exposure: A12 GSE308103 pilot report, specification and script; exploratory with twelve primary paired patients.
Kim/GSE131907 earlier A11 results exist in repository; its metadata and historical coverage audits were inspected. Kim is not wholly untouched.
Historical audit reports zero unchanged primary epithelial paired triads for Kim. Recount A12-specific source/recipient units from original annotation.

fixed_instrument.unit: patient, pooled repeated libraries; LUAD minus same-patient normal
fixed_instrument.recipient: existing fixed AT2 candidate state in each arm; independently adjudicated correspondence required
fixed_instrument.source: broad assigned macrophages; retains conditional attribution
fixed_instrument.source_mixture: fraction of assigned macrophages labelled Monocyte-derived Mph; monocytes or all myeloid cells are not substitutes
fixed_instrument.recipient_index: mean log2(1+full-library CPM) IL1R1,IL1RAP minus mean IL1R2,IL1RN,SIGIRR; paired difference
fixed_instrument.response: exact 197-gene predictor-disjoint TNF/NFkB hallmark in pilot specification; mean log2(1+full-library CPM), paired difference
fixed_instrument.normalization: raw count pseudobulk using full assay library denominator; no alias rescue or zero-filling absent genes
fixed_instrument.fit: ridge alpha=1; train-only mean and population SD; unpenalized intercept; unchanged five pilot feature sets
fixed_instrument.primary_comparison: joint versus alternative (source IL1A, IL1B, mixture and TNF), same patients
prohibited_changes: reference mapping with tested predictor/outcome genes
normalized expression without raw full-library instrument comparability

ordered_gates: independent human untreated primary LUAD and same-patient normal; patient/sample accession crosswalk and no pilot overlap
unchanged AT2 correspondence in both arms and broad assigned macrophages with identifiable Monocyte-derived Mph fraction; independent annotation provenance
intersection of paired source and recipient arms at the 50-cell floor; report cell counts and excluded patients
raw count and full-library normalization comparability; >=70 percent response genes and all component genes; no outcome values inspected to resolve metadata gates
minimum ten eligible pairs for exploratory algorithm replication; sufficient-precision gate separately requires at least 46 independent external patient pairs for fixed-model loss assessment
root commits this specification and candidate-specific admissible mapping before scores; separately serialize and commit all-pilot fitted parameters before external outcomes if eligible

validation_target.pilot_artifact: LOPO predictions exist, not one deployed fitted model. Those predictions cannot be transported as fitted coefficients.
validation_target.frozen_model_validation: If all gates pass, fit unchanged feature sets once to all twelve primary pilot AT2 pairs; save training means/SDs/intercepts/coefficients and hashes; commit before external score access. External data do not refit or recalibrate predictions.
validation_target.algorithm_replication: Fixed-algorithm LOPO inside an independent cohort tests the algorithm at its training size, not transport of a frozen pilot fitted model. Ten to forty-five pairs allow descriptive replication only; overlapping-fold losses receive no ordinary paired t interval.
validation_target.no_eligible_cohort: No model fit, response extraction, effect estimate, or negative biological conclusion. Publish metadata gate results and unresolved information.

all_models: calibration intercept and slope with uncertainty
evaluation_if_eligible.primary_effect: mean paired loss improvement: squared error alternative minus squared error joint
evaluation_if_eligible.precision: Independent external fixed-model losses: 95 percent t half-width target <=0.30 between-patient loss SD (46 pairs gives approximately 0.297). A planning precision criterion, not biological equivalence or guaranteed interval coverage; report instability/outliers without changing membership.
evaluation_if_eligible.claim_limit: General inflammatory RNA prediction conditional on annotations. No IL1 specificity, activation, causality, unconditional macrophage source attribution, or equivalence claim.

audit_outputs: gate decisions distinguishing unknown from zero
